form_subtitle_transaction: Propose a treasury transfer from the realm vault.
form_subtitle_upgrade: Install or upgrade a codex, extension, or core orchestration action.
form_subtitle_poll: Ask the realm a question — no automated action if approved.
form_subtitle_code_execution: Submit Python code to run on the realm backend if approved.
no_proposals_filtered: No proposals match the current filters
effective_at_hint: Optional. Without it, the proposal runs as soon as it is accepted. With it, it runs at this time, in the realm's official time ({zone}), and never earlier; if voting ends after this time, it expires and nothing runs. The time cannot change once the proposal is accepted, so leave a margin.
effective_at_gap: This time does not exist in {zone}: the clocks go forward then. Choose another.
effective_at_twice: This time happens twice in {zone}, because the clocks go back: {first} and {second}. Choose another.
effective_at_invalid: Enter a date and a time.
effective_at_past: The time it takes effect must be in the future
stop_explain: This proposal was accepted and is waiting for its time to take effect. Stopping it ends it as withdrawn: its action will never run. Where a department's policy needs a vote, this files a proposal to stop it.
stop_done: Proposal {id} is stopped: its action will never run.
stop_filed: A stop proposal was filed: {id}. This proposal stops once that one is accepted.
links_hint: Optional. Links are fixed when the proposal is filed, at most {max} in all.
links_replaces_none: You have no withdrawn proposal to replace
links_replaces_help: One of your withdrawn proposals that no other proposal replaces yet.
links_full: A proposal has at most {max} links.
links_bad_ref: Type a proposal number, such as 12.
vote_can_change: You can change your vote until voting ends.
vote_is_final: Voting has ended, so your vote can no longer change.
waiting_one: Waiting for 1 more voter or the deadline
waiting_many: Waiting for {count} more voters or the deadline
waiting_one_open: Waiting for 1 more voter, or until the outcome is certain
waiting_many_open: Waiting for {count} more voters, or until the outcome is certain
waiting_department_open: Waiting for {what}: it stays open until it passes or everyone has voted
waiting_quorum: enough votes to reach the quorum
waiting_vetoed: a veto holder to change their no
